description:
Choose a story, make the next choice, and watch your decision become a cinematic scene. IF Drama turns interactive storytelling into an unfolding video experience shaped by you.

DISCOVER STORIES
Browse character-led mystery, adventure, and drama worlds, then open the one you want to explore.

MAKE THE NEXT CHOICE
Choose a suggested action or write your own response to decide how your story continues.

WATCH THE SCENE
Your decision continues as a generated video scene with dialogue, action, and sound.

KEEP YOUR STORY GOING
Return to your history, revisit generated scenes, and continue from the choices you made.

IF Drama uses Coins for story and video generation. Coin packs are available as one-time consumable in-app purchases. Generation time and results can vary.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Kinda pricey but there are options to choose from with the spending. As long as you type in good detail you won’t mess up and have to waste your coins fixing it. The two things I would change 1: add a monthly subscription 2: change the loading bar when waiting for a video to be made.

I’m really liking how the app works. It’s a very unique experience with video interactions being the main feature. The AI does make some very AI mistakes with unnatural features, but there’s only so much you can do there. I also wish the app gave you free coins as incentives to login to the app each day. Right now the only method is purchasing coins.

Still new and you can tell the devs actually care.  Lots of content with the same prompt but different characters, and the movie style responses are really cool.  However, it’s pretty expensive, which is reasonable since the AI response is a video.
